about: Raw map data for the map pipeline, kept in data/raw/ (not stored in git). Files with access 'whole' (the default) are downloaded by tools/map/fetch.mjs; access 'range' marks big rasters that tools/map/build-grids.mjs reads window by window through tools/map/fetch-grids.mjs, with {NN} (a class number) or {tile} (a tile name) in the url filled in by the builder. 'files' are small extra files (legends, licences, manuals) fetched whole. licenceStatus is 'read' only once the licence was read on the owner's own host and quoted here (licenceReadAt says where; licenceQuote is verbatim); a shipped map file built from an 'unverified' source fails the build. 'credit' is what the in-game Credits screen and ATTRIBUTION.md show (tools/map/attribution.mjs writes both): owner, version, short (the name on the map's credit line), onMap (whether that short name stays on the map's credit line at all times), line, citation, changes, notes, licenceName and licenceUri (no scheme: the game page may not contain web addresses). The lead keeps data/sources.md in step with this file.

sources.what: NKG_RF17vel, the Nordic Geodetic Commission's velocity model of the land in the Nordic and Baltic countries (the model of the NKG2020 transformation): a GeoTIFF of 301 x 313 points every 1/6 degree of longitude and 1/12 degree of latitude from 0E 75N (0-50E, 49-75N), three float32 bands (east_velocity, north_velocity, up_velocity, millimetres per year) stored as separate planes, DEFLATE, file dated 2020-11-04. Only up_velocity is used: how fast the land rises (relative to the Earth's centre, not to the sea). Pinned to PROJ-data release 1.25.0; the same file (identical SHA-256, 515f68ae...0d66) is on the NKG's own site at www.nordicgeodeticcommission.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/eur_nkg_nkgrf17vel.tif, linked from its Products page.

sources.what: SGU's shore-displacement model (Strandförskjutningsmodell, öppna data): GeoPackage files per 1000 years, each with one polygon table per 100 years named issjohav_<cal BP> (years before 1950), in SWEREF 99 TM (EPSG:3006); column Code: 1 sea, 2 ice-dammed lake, 4 lake, 5 ice (land is where no polygon lies). Built from shore-displacement curves and a 50 m height model in Sweden (Påsse and Daniels 2015). The file for 1-900 BP covers AD 1050-1950, the game's years.
